checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'arabic-copy-qa'.

checks.description: All seven Arabic checks are defined: MSA Gulf-familiar, Thmanyah tone, no tatweel, Western numerals, no em dash, empowering, RTL-safe.
checks.rule: Body lists msa-gulf-familiar, thmanyah-tone, no-tatweel, western-numerals, no-em-dash, empowering-framing, rtl-safe.

checks.description: Runs after the skill eval and before brand-qa-reviewer, only on Arabic copy.
checks.rule: Body states it runs after the skill eval and before brand-qa-reviewer, on Arabic copy only, per verification.md.

checks.description: On fail, returns a structured fix list with check, quoted span, and fix per item.
checks.rule: Output defines a per-item shape of check, span (quoted), fix; pass advances, fail returns the list.

checks.description: It never edits the copy; it is a verifier that passes or fails.
checks.rule: Hard rules state never edit the copy, binary pass or fail, no item waved through.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669); digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel in the file, and the RTL-safe check is encoded.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+0640 tatweel characters and defines an rtl-safe check for mixed direction and numerals.

checks.description: Encodes the empowering, never deficit-framed check.
checks.rule: The empowering-framing check verifies copy speaks to what the reader can build, with no shame or hype, per brand-voice.md.
